steps.title: Thaw and vortex samples
steps.instruction: Defrost samples, gently vortex to resuspend material.

steps.title: Load samples into lysis rack
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of each sample to a tube in the 96‑tube lysis rack, record tube positions, and leave one tube empty as a negative extraction control.

steps.title: Add DNA/RNA shield
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Zymo DNA/RNA Shield to each tube and seal the rack with the supplied cap films.

steps.title: Bead‑beat lysate
steps.instruction: Secure the rack in a Qiagen TissueLyser II (or equivalent) and lyse at 20 Hz for 20 min (00:20:00).

steps.title: Centrifuge before uncapping
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sealed rack at 3000 × g for 5 min (00:05:00).

steps.title: Add Proteinase K and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL Proteinase K to each tube, then incubate at 65 °C for 20 min (00:20:00).

steps.title: Prepare BME‑supplemented lysis buffer
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, add 750 µL β‑mercaptoethanol (BME) to the genomic lysis buffer bottle and invert to mix.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to 96‑well block
steps.instruction: Transfer 250 µL of the lysed supernatant from each tube to the same‑position well of a 96‑well block.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate block
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 96‑well block at 3000 × g for 5 min (00:05:00).

steps.title: Add BME‑lysis buffer to block
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL of the BME‑supplemented genomic lysis buffer to each well, pipette up‑and‑down to mix, and seal with an adhesive plate seal.

steps.title: Transfer to silicon‑A plate
steps.instruction: Remove the seal, transfer 500 µL from each well of the block to the corresponding well of a silicon‑A plate mounted on a collection plate, then reseal the silicon‑A plate.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect flow‑through
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3000 × g for 5 min (00:05:00), discard the flow‑through into a hazardous‑waste bottle, and return the silicon‑A plate to the collection plate. Repeat until all supernatant has been processed.

steps.title: DNA pre‑wash buffer
steps.instruction: Remove the seal, add 200 µL DNA pre‑wash buffer to each well of the silicon‑A plate, reseal, centrifuge at 3000 × g for 5 min, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: g‑DNA wash buffer
steps.instruction: Remove the seal, add 500 µL g‑DNA wash buffer to each well, reseal, centrifuge at 3000 × g for 5 min, and discard the flow‑through. Set the silicon‑A plate aside until step 25.

steps.title: HRC plate preparation
steps.instruction: Place a High‑Recovery (HRC) plate on an elution plate, pierce the cover foil, add 150 µL prep solution to each HRC well, and incubate at room temperature for 5 min (00:05:00).

steps.title: Collect HRC eluate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the HRC‑elution assembly at 3000 × g for 5 min, discard the flow‑through from the elution plate into hazardous waste.

steps.title: Elute DNA from silicon‑A
steps.instruction: Remove the seal from the silicon‑A plate, place it onto the prepared HRC plate, assemble the three‑plate stack onto a fresh elution plate, add 100 µL DNA elution buffer to each silicon‑A well, reseal, and centrifuge at 3500 × g for 5 min (00:05:00).

steps.title: Seal and store eluate
steps.instruction: Seal the elution plate with an adhesive seal, label, and store at 4 °C (up to 1 week) or at –20 °C to –70 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Nanodrop quantification
steps.instruction: Clean the Nanodrop pedestal with molecular‑grade water, blank with 1 µL elution buffer, pipette 1 µL of each DNA sample onto the pedestal, close the lid, measure, and record concentration and 260/280 & 260/230 ratios.

steps.title: QuantiFluor ONE quantification
steps.instruction: Prepare DNA standards as listed in Table 1, add 200 µL QuantiFluor dye to each well of a black microplate, add 1 µL of each standard (or sample) in duplicate/triplicate, vortex gently, incubate 5 min at room temperature, read fluorescence at 504 nm excitation / 531 nm emission, and calculate concentrations from the standard curve.

steps.title: Quant‑iT HS quantification
steps.instruction: Dilute Quant‑iT HS reagent 1:200 in buffer, add 200 µL to each well of a black microplate, add 10 µL of each standard or DNA sample, vortex gently, incubate 5 min at room temperature, read fluorescence at 502 nm excitation / 523 nm emission, and calculate concentrations from the standard curve.

steps.title: Prepare PCR product for indexing
steps.instruction: Transfer 20 µL of PCR product to a Millipore MultiScreen PCR plate, add 80 µL TE buffer, pipette up‑and‑down to mix and avoid bubbles.

steps.title: Prepare indexing primer arrays
steps.instruction: Defrost primers, centrifuge at 1000 × g for 1 min, then use a liquid‑handling robot to combine 20 µL of each 50 µM forward and reverse indexing primer with 360 µL molecular‑grade water in a 96‑deep‑well block (final 0.5 µM). Transfer 5 µL of each master array to a separate PCR plate, seal all plates with adhesive seals.

steps.title: Normalize PCR product (Norgen kit)
steps.instruction: Add 60 µL Buffer SK to 20 µL PCR product, mix, and transfer the entire mixture to a 96‑well normalization plate mounted on a collection plate; seal with an adhesive plate seal.

steps.title: Vacuum dry normalized plate
steps.instruction: Place the sealed plate on a vacuum manifold, apply 0.7 Bar vacuum for 12 min (00:12:00) until wells are empty, then blot any droplets.

steps.title: Rehydrate normalized DNA
steps.instruction: Add 35 µL molecular‑grade water to each well, vortex at 1100 rpm for 10 min (00:10:00).

steps.title: Store cleaned PCR product
steps.instruction: Transfer the rehydrated PCR product to a PCR plate and store at 4 °C (up to 1 week) or at –20 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Set up indexing PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Dispense master mix into a reagent reservoir, transfer 18 µL to each well of the primer‑array plate (avoid touching primers), then add 2 µL of cleaned PCR product to each well, note sample positions, include at least one well with 2 µL negative extraction blank as a PCR negative control, and seal.

steps.title: Centrifuge indexing plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the plate at 1000 × g for 1 min (00:01:00).

steps.title: Run indexing PCR
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a thermocycler and run: 95 °C 2 min; 8 cycles of 95 °C 15 s, 50 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; final extension 72 °C 10 min.

steps.title: Post‑PCR spin‑column cleanup – first spin
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3200 × g for 2 min (00:02:00) and discard the flow‑through into hazardous waste.

steps.title: Prepare Wash Solution A
steps.instruction: Add 90 mL 100 % ethanol to Wash Solution A bottle, invert to mix.

steps.title: Wash step A
steps.instruction: Remove the plate seal, add 400 µL Wash Solution A (with ethanol) to each well of the normalization plate, reseal.

steps.title: Centrifuge wash A
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 3200 × g for 2 min (00:02:00), discard flow‑through into hazardous waste.

steps.title: Repeat wash A (second wash)
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 400 µL Wash Solution A and centrifugation; after the second wash, centrifuge at 3200 × g for 15 min (00:15:00).

steps.title: Elute from normalization plate
steps.instruction: Place the normalization plate on an elution plate, remove the seal, add 100 µL elution buffer to each well, centrifuge at 200 × g for 1 min then at 3200 × g for 5 min.

steps.title: Prepare 2 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Combine 100 mL 1× TBE with 2 g agarose, melt, cool to ~50 °C, add 5 mL GelRed or SYBR Safe, mix, pour into a gel tray with combs, allow to set 10 min (00:10:00), then place the gel in a tank with 1× TBE.

steps.title: Run library gel
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL loading buffer to the library, add 5 µL 100 kb ladder to a lane, load samples, and run at 90 V for 1 h (01:00:00).

steps.title: Excise library band
steps.instruction: Place the gel on a UV light box, cut the library band with a sterile scalpel, transfer to a pre‑weighed Eppendorf tube, and weigh to determine gel slice mass.

steps.title: Pool normalized PCR products
steps.instruction: Pool the normalized PCR product from each plate into a single centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Quantify pool with Qubit HS
steps.instruction: Dilute Qubit dsDNA HS stain 1:200 in buffer, add 190 µL diluted stain to a Qubit tube, add 10 µL of the pooled sample (plus two standards and two extra for pipetting error), vortex, incubate 2 min at room temperature, then measure fluorescence.

steps.title: Normalize and combine amplicon pools
steps.instruction: Dilute an aliquot of each plate pool with elution buffer to 50 µL to achieve a normalized concentration, then pool all plate pools of the same amplicon (different amplicons are pooled separately).

steps.title: Gel‑extracted library cleanup – incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the pooled library at 50 °C for 10 min (00:10:00), inverting periodically until the gel is fully dissolved.

steps.title: Isopropanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of isopropanol to the dissolved sample and invert to mix.

steps.title: Bind DNA to MinElute column
steps.instruction: Transfer up to 700 µL of the sample to a MinElute spin column in a collection tube, centrifuge at 17900 × g for 1 min (00:01:00), discard flow‑through, and repeat until the entire sample has passed through the column.

steps.title: Wash column with PE buffer
steps.instruction: Add 100 % ethanol to Buffer PE as instructed, then add 750 µL Buffer PE (with ethanol) to the spin column, let stand 5 min.

steps.title: Centrifuge wash steps
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 17900 × g for 1 min, discard flow‑through, then repeat the centrifugation step once more.

steps.title: Elute DNA from column
steps.instruction: Place the spin column into a clean Eppendorf tube, add 100 µL elution buffer, let stand 1 min, then centrifuge at 17900 × g for 1 min to collect eluate.

steps.title: Store final library
steps.instruction: Store the eluate at 4 °C (up to 1 week) or at –20 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Quantify gel‑extracted library
steps.instruction: Measure concentration (aim 0.2–0.6 ng/µL) using the chosen quantification method and dilute with elution buffer if necessary.

steps.title: Calculate molarity and pool libraries
steps.instruction: Calculate each amplicon’s molarity from its length and Qubit reading, pool amplicons in equimolar ratios, then dilute the final pool to 1000 pM for NextSeq (on‑board denaturation) or 400 pM for MiSeq (manual denaturation).

steps.title: Prepare final library PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Dispense master mix into a reservoir, transfer 48 µL to each well of a PCR plate.

steps.title: Add library DNA to PCR
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of the normalized library DNA to each well, note sample positions, include at least one well with 2 µL negative extraction blank as a PCR negative control, mix, and seal with an adhesive seal.

steps.title: Centrifuge final PCR plate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1000 × g for 1 min (00:01:00).

steps.title: Run final library PCR
steps.instruction: Place the plate in a thermocycler and run the program for each primer set as listed in Table 5 (e.g., 16S: 95 °C 2 min; 8 cycles of 95 °C 15 s, 50 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; final 72 °C 10 min; other amplicons have their own cycling parameters).

steps.title: Prepare 1.5 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Combine 250 mL 1× TBE with 3.75 g agarose, melt, cool to ~50 °C, add 5 mL GelRed or SYBR Safe, pour into a gel tray, set 20 min (00:20:00), then place gel in a tank with 1× TBE.

steps.title: Run PCR product gel
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL loading buffer to 5 µL of each PCR product, load wells, add 5 µL 100 kb ladder to at least one well per row, and run at 130 V for 45 min (00:45:00).

steps.title: Visualise PCR gels
steps.instruction: Place the gel on a UV transilluminator (e.g., BioRad GelDoc) and capture an image to assess amplification success and product size.
